content.introduction: The S&P 500 closed at 7,541.40, down 38.67 points or 0.51%, according to Investing.com. The sources also mention that the S&P 500 VIX increased by 1.73 points to 21.15, and the Dollar Index rose by 0.049 to 101.673. Crude Oil WTI Futures climbed by 0.16 to 96.62, while Gold Futures dropped by 30.13 to 3,939.47. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to the overall market performance or future trends.
